verdicts.reason: A rewraps the headline into four bold lines that fill the portrait width, so it dominates and the CTA sits close beneath it. Its main flaw is that the whole block sits low: about 170px of empty space at the top against about 50px under the button, which makes it bottom-heavy. B keeps the landscape two-line wrap at a small size, so the headline lines run almost to the side edges while large dead areas sit above and below. The gap between headline and CTA is also too wide, so B looks like a shrunk copy, not a layout redesigned for portrait.
